answer_1.quote: DOCMATH-EVAL evaluates the LLMs' performance in the context of understanding and analyzing financial documents containing both text and tables. The models are required to first locate question-relevant data points within lengthy documents, and then apply numerical reasoning and specialized financial knowledge to answer the question.

answer_2.quote: To obtain the best candidate answer â, we use greedy decoding in all our LLM evaluations.

answer_4.quote: To give a general yet insightful estimate of the performance on each of the DOCMATH-EVAL sets, we enlisted two professionals who hold Chartered Financial Analyst licenses to conduct the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: We randomly sample 25 examples from each set, asking the expert evaluators to answer the questions individually within a four-hour period.
